phases.title: Researching issue 450
phases.summary: Traced flaky saved card test in issue 450 to a fixed 2 s wait; slow runners exceed it, and two other specs share it.

phases.title: Fixing checkout spec waits
phases.summary: Replaced the saved card wait with a frame locator, applied the same change to coupon and refund specs, and repeated checkout runs 20 times, all passing.

phases.title: Diagnosing refund e2e failure
phases.summary: Ran e2e specs, found refund test failing due to seeding twice in beforeEach, then moved seed into test body.

phases.title: Verifying e2e suite passes
phases.summary: Re-ran e2e folder, getting 42 of 42 passing after the refund seed fix.

phases.title: Opening PR 512 for waits
phases.summary: Opened pull request 512 to wait for the payment frame in e2e specs, closing issue 450.

phases.title: Reviewing PR 512 readiness
phases.summary: Checked PR 512's e2e results, refactored the repeated locator into a helper, renamed it per Maya's comment, and confirmed it is approved and ready for a person to merge.

phases.title: Researching issue 440
phases.summary: Opened issue 440 about login losing the return page, then traced the cause to a read after the cookie is cleared in redirect.ts.

phases.title: Fixing auth tests for PR 513
phases.summary: Fixed redirect ordering and the fake clock in auth tests, so all 42 pass, then opened PR 513 closing issue 440.

phases.title: Drafting v2.3.0 release notes
phases.summary: Drafted v2.3.0 notes from 14 merged PRs, listed 11 closed issues, and updated the receipt snapshot after one failing test.
